title: Framer header
description: A fixed 64px black bar: wordmark and five quiet nav items (some with chevrons and small hover menus) on the left, a grey Log in link and a small white Sign up button on the right. On phones: wordmark, Log in, Sign up and a two-line menu button that opens a full-height list. The two actions fade in on load.
notes: fixed to the top with its own 64px spacer, so the next block starts below it
the phone menu is a <details> element: no JavaScript
name: framer-header
